name: qahub
description: Claude writes Playwright tests while it builds your app and sends them to QA Hub. Needs a QA Hub API key.

api_key.title: QA Hub API key
api_key.description: From QA Hub → Account → API keys. Claude Code keeps it as a secret setting (the system keychain on macOS), never in your project's files.

server.title: QA Hub address
server.description: The address you open QA Hub at — shown on QA Hub's Claude setup page. Leave as is for app.qahub.dev.
